cases.description: Empty input fails before grammar matching.
cases.notes: Covers schema-level empty-input rejection.

cases.description: A token missing component_id_v0_2 fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: The label must not repair a missing primary id.

cases.description: Duplicate token_id fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: Duplicate token identity is not an invalid type combination.

cases.description: Duplicate sequence_index fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: P1-A groups duplicate and invalid sequence-index failures under INPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID.

cases.description: Negative sequence_index fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: The parser must fail before production matching.

cases.description: Malformed component id fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: Malformed ids are not sent to D1 normalization.

cases.description: Unknown lexical_component_type fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: Unknown lexical type is schema invalid, not PR-UNKNOWN.

cases.description: Non-integer sequence_index fails input contract validation.
cases.notes: Input-contract validation precedes all grammar behavior.

cases.description: Right-hand action plus numeric string with no sound state and no explicit context remains ambiguous.
cases.notes: Locked P1-A decision: RH_ACTION + STRING_NUMBER is not silently open-string.

cases.description: Caller declares no inherited context; RH plus string resolves as local open-string candidate.
cases.notes: This resolves because the caller supplied an explicit context boundary, not because tokenization guessed the numeric role.

cases.description: Explicit open-string state marker plus RH string yields resolved open-string local unit.
cases.notes: P1 records only the local state marker; span reconstruction remains outside P1.

cases.description: Caller-provided inherited context makes RH plus string valid with context.
cases.notes: P1 validates explicit context only.

cases.description: Declared context requirement without context_ref or inherited_context is incomplete.
cases.notes: Distinguishes incomplete missing context from invalid order.

cases.description: Explicit context exists but conflicts with token role expectations, so the parse remains unresolved.
cases.notes: Differentiates unresolved incompatible context from incomplete missing context.

cases.description: A request to search parser history is outside P1 and unsupported.
cases.notes: P1-C must reject history scan requests instead of performing them.

cases.description: Explicit left finger, hui numeric, right-hand action, and string numeric produce a complete pressed unit.
cases.notes: This is the most specific basic pressed-unit production.

cases.description: Right-hand action alone is a legal fragment but incomplete without string number.
cases.notes: May become valid only when paired with a string token.

cases.description: Numeric alone is ambiguous and must not be pre-decided as hui or string.
cases.notes: This case intentionally has no surface reading candidate.

cases.description: Left finger alone cannot create a sounding unit.
cases.notes: May be context source later, not a P1 sounding unit.

cases.description: Left finger plus hui lacks right-hand action and string.
cases.notes: Pressed position may establish reviewable context only.

cases.description: Numeric string before right-hand action violates P1 local order.
cases.notes: Future lattice phases may revisit segmentation; P1 local parser rejects.

cases.description: Timing marker cannot be mixed into sounding slots without explicit boundary.
cases.notes: Parser may split only when a boundary is explicit.

cases.description: State end marker is legal and non-sounding.
cases.notes: Closing a span belongs to later context phases.

cases.description: Timing marker alone is a valid non-sounding local marker.
cases.notes: Timing marker does not supply sound type or right-hand action.

cases.description: Pre-sound motion attaches to a following pressed sounding host.
cases.notes: Abstract surface is local and illustrative only.

cases.description: Pre-sound motion without following host is incomplete.
cases.notes: Unhosted pre-motion is incomplete, not complete.

cases.description: Post-sound motion attaches to the preceding host.
cases.notes: The host context is explicit, not discovered.

cases.description: Post-sound motion without preceding host is incomplete.
cases.notes: Also covers previous-unit scan request rejection.

cases.description: Registered generic marker with whitelisted subtype is valid and non-sounding.
cases.notes: Whitelisted subtype is required for accepted generic marker parse.

cases.description: Unregistered generic marker is unsupported.
cases.notes: PR-GENERIC-MARKER cannot accept unknown subtype.

cases.description: Known generic marker subtype with unclear behavior stays unresolved.
cases.notes: Known subtype is not enough when behavior is not whitelisted.

cases.description: Special technique may attach to explicit host while remaining orthogonal to sound type.
cases.notes: Expansion remains reviewable.

cases.description: Special technique that declares attachment requirement but lacks host is incomplete.
cases.notes: Missing attachment is incomplete, not a fourth sound type.

cases.description: Special technique must not be accepted as a fourth sound type.
cases.notes: Sound type remains only 散, 按, 泛.

cases.description: Special technique with unclear sounding policy remains unresolved for review.
cases.notes: Unresolved differs from incomplete: host exists but policy is unclear.

cases.description: Unknown component cannot be force matched.
cases.notes: PR-UNKNOWN is fallback only.

cases.description: Sequence outside P1 local grammar is unsupported.
cases.notes: Unsupported differs from unresolved: grammar scope is absent.

cases.description: PR-UNKNOWN may appear only in unresolved or rejected channels, never accepted valid candidates.
cases.notes: Explicit acceptance guard for the fallback production.

cases.description: Two right-hand actions competing for one slot remain ambiguous unless a compound rule is explicit.
cases.notes: Ambiguity is preserved for later segmentation.

cases.description: Two numeric tokens competing for one string slot remain ambiguous.
cases.notes: Numeric clusters may be range, two units, or unresolved.

cases.description: Valid local parse with an extra token must record unconsumed tokens.
cases.notes: Partial consumption must be observable in output.

cases.description: Legacy id without normalized v0.2 primary id produces normalization gap.
cases.notes: Normalization gap does not fabricate registry entries.

cases.description: Grammar-plausible candidate that hits scoped hard guard is rejected.
cases.notes: Scoped literal policy: the forbidden string is not globally banned outside matching scope.
